name: Sarah Chavez Harkins
prior_offices: Carbon County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Sarah Chavez Harkins, also listed as Sarah Chavez-Harkins, is the Carbon County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official attorney page lists her in that office. The Rawlins Times reported that she was among the county officials who won at the polls.

sources.name: Rawlins Times, Nov. 4, 2026, Carbon County sees no real surprises in 2026 midterm elections
